name: XANO Industri AB (publ)
summary: XANO Industri AB (publ) develops, manufactures, and sells industrial products and automation equipment in Sweden, rest of Nordic countries, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through Industrial Products, Industrial Solutions, and Precision Technology segments.
